provenance.config_snapshot:
# ── Usambara Bauxite Belt (Tanzania) configuration ────────────────────
# Covers the lateritic bauxite plateaus in the West Usambara Mountains

# Common analysis grid
grid:
  crs: "EPSG:32737"        # UTM Zone 37S — covers Tanzania
  resolution_m: 30          # 30 m to match SRTM / Landsat
  # AOI bounding box in WGS 84 (lon, lat)
  aoi_wgs84:
    min_lon: 38.0
    max_lon: 39.0
    min_lat: -5.5
    max_lat: -4.2
  # Derived extent in target CRS (filled at runtime)
  aoi_utm: null             # [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] in metres

# ── Data sources ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sources:
  usgs_mrds:
    name: "USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS)"
    shapefile_url: "https://mrdata.usgs.gov/mrds/mrds-trim.zip"
    csv_url: "https://mrdata.usgs.gov/mrds/mrds-csv.zip"
    wfs_url: "https://mrdata.usgs.gov/services/wfs/mrds"
    commodities:
      - "Bauxite"
      - "Aluminum"
    africa_bbox:
      min_lon: 10.0
      max_lon: 50.0
      min_lat: -35.0
      max_lat: 37.0

  sentinel2:
    collection: "COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED"
    bands:
      - B2   # Blue   (10 m)
      - B3   # Green  (10 m)
      - B4   # Red    (10 m)
      - B8   # NIR    (10 m)
      - B11   # SWIR1  (20 m)
      - B12   # SWIR2  (20 m)
    date_range:
      start: "2023-06-01"
      end: "2023-09-30"
    cloud_cover_threshold: 0.20
    scale_m: 30

  srtm_dem:
    collection: "USGS/SRTMGL1_003"
    resolution_m: 30

# ── Feature engineering ───────────────────────────────────────────────
features:
  # Explicit feature-raster allowlist (SAFEGUARD)
  rasters_by_group:
    bauxite:
      - dem/srtm_usambara_aligned.tif
      - sentinel2/sentinel2_usambara_aligned.tif
      - features/terrain_features_usambara.tif
      - features/geology_features_usambara.tif
      - features/alteration_features_usambara.tif
      - features/deposit_distance_bauxite.tif

  bauxite:
    spectral_indices:
      - NDWI   # Normalized Difference Water Index
      - MBI    # Mud-sand Bimodal Index (for laterite)
      - BSI    # Brightness/Surface Index
    slope_threshold_deg: 5
    plateau_flatness: true

# ── Model settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
model:
  commodity_groups:
    - bauxite
  algorithm: "random_forest"
  params:
    n_estimators: 500
    max_depth: 15
    min_samples_leaf: 3
    random_state: 42
  compare_algorithms:
    - random_forest
    - xgboost
    - lightgbm

# ── Spatial cross-validation ───────────────────────────────────────────
validation:
  method: "spatial_block"
  n_groups: 3
  buffer_km: 5
  min_train_area_pct: 60

# ── Karagwe-Ankole Belt (KAB) configuration ───────────────────────────
# Covers the KAB in Rwanda, with Sn-W-Ta targets (tin, tungsten, tantalum)
# plus shared infrastructure data from USGS MRDS.

# Common analysis grid
grid:
  crs: "EPSG:32736"        # UTM Zone 36S — covers Rwanda
  resolution_m: 30          # 30 m to match SRTM / Landsat
  # AOI bounding box in WGS 84 (lon, lat)
  aoi_wgs84:
    min_lon: 29.4
    max_lon: 30.6
    min_lat: -2.4
    max_lat: -1.2
  # Derived extent in target CRS (filled at runtime)
  aoi_utm: null             # [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] in metres

# ── Data sources ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sources:
  usgs_mrds:
    name: "USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS)"
    shapefile_url: "https://mrdata.usgs.gov/mrds/mrds-trim.zip"
    csv_url: "https://mrdata.usgs.gov/mrds/mrds-csv.zip"
    wfs_url: "https://mrdata.usgs.gov/services/wfs/mrds"
    commodities:
      - "Tin"             # MRDS commodity code: Sn-related
      - "Tungsten"
      - "Tantalum"
      - "Copper"
      - "Zinc"
      - "Bauxite"
      - "Aluminum"        # MRDS uses this for bauxite/alumina
    africa_bbox:
      min_lon: 10.0       # westernmost Africa longitude
      max_lon: 50.0       # easternmost Africa longitude
      min_lat: -35.0      # southernmost Africa latitude
      max_lat: 37.0       # northernmost Africa latitude

  sentinel2:
    collection: "COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED"
    bands:
      - B2   # Blue   (10 m)
      - B3   # Green  (10 m)
      - B4   # Red    (10 m)
      - B8   # NIR    (10 m)
      - B11   # SWIR1  (20 m)
      - B12   # SWIR2  (20 m)
    # Dry season in Rwanda: June–September (Southern Hemisphere winter)
    date_range:
      start: "2023-06-01"
      end: "2023-09-30"
    cloud_cover_threshold: 0.20
    scale_m: 30           # resample all bands to 30 m

  srtm_dem:
    collection: "USGS/SRTMGL1_003"
    resolution_m: 30

# ── Feature engineering ───────────────────────────────────────────────
features:
  # Explicit feature-raster allowlist (SAFEGUARD): paths relative to
  # data/interim. Only these files may enter training / prediction for
  # the group — a stray GeoTIFF in data/interim cannot poison the model.
  rasters_by_group:
    tin_tungsten_tantalum:
      - dem/srtm_kabar_aligned.tif
      - sentinel2/sentinel2_kabar_aligned.tif
      - features/terrain_features_kabar.tif
      - features/geology_features_kabar.tif
      - features/alteration_features_kabar.tif
      - features/deposit_distance_tin_tungsten_tantalum.tif

  # Sn / W / Ta (Karagwe-Ankole Belt)
  tin_tungsten_tantalum:
    distance_to:
      - faults
      - granite_contacts
    magnetic_gradients: true
    lithology_encoding: true

  # Cu / Zn (Central African Copperbelt)
  copper_zinc:
    stratigraphic_proxies: true
    structural_traps: true
    geochemical_anomaly_surfaces: true

  # Bauxite (lateritic plateaus, Tanzania)
  bauxite:
    spectral_indices:
      - NDWI   # Normalized Difference Water Index
      - MBI    # Mud-sand Bimodal Index (for laterite)
      - BSI    # Brightness/Surface Index
    slope_threshold_deg: 5
    plateau_flatness: true

# ── Model settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
model:
  commodity_groups:
    - tin_tungsten_tantalum
    - copper_zinc
    - bauxite
  algorithm: "random_forest"
  params:
    # Tuned via Optuna TPE (50 trials, spatial CV) — best xgb config:
    # mean AP 0.082 vs 0.037 default.
    n_estimators: 150
    max_depth: 3
    learning_rate: 0.298
    subsample: 0.917
    colsample_bytree: 0.593
    min_child_weight: 7
    min_samples_leaf: 3
    random_state: 42
  compare_algorithms:
    - random_forest
    - xgboost
    - lightgbm

# ── Spatial cross-validation ───────────────────────────────────────────
validation:
  method: "spatial_block"
  n_groups: 5
  buffer_km: 5
  min_train_area_pct: 60
